title: Grateful Dead Live at Roscoe Maples Pavilion, Stanford on 1973-02-09
source: SBD>>MR>>REEL>>DAT>>SS>>CDR>>DAW(Bertha)>>CDA>>SHN>>COOL EDIT PRO>>SHN; Speed-corrected using Celemony Capstan done for each track individually; Reencoded to flac (level 8); SBE's fixed using Trader's Little Helper

ai_review.summary: Super‑clean soundboard capture of a solid show highlighted by a smoking "El Paso" and strong Phil backing vocals.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear, crisp sound – likely a high‑quality soundboard (or matrix) mix with well‑balanced vocals and instruments. The performance itself is described as a solid set with standout moments on "El Paso" and notably good vocal support from Phil. Overall the show feels energetic and collectible.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers consistently praise the pristine recording quality (≈4.5/5) and note a good, if not legendary, performance (≈3.5/5). Weighted combination yields ~3.8 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as super clean, crisp, with clear vocal‑instrument balance; possible matrix but essentially a high‑fidelity board capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on flow, but reviewers imply a cohesive, strong opening that set the tone for the night.

band_member_comments.Phil: Backing vocals highlighted as a key strength of the performance.
